config.augmentation_counts: floor(original class count * ratio); ROS matches every actually admitted GAN class count

basis.CNN: One predeclared convolutional representation control; no hyperparameter search; parameter count and compute cost reported
basis.G1: ACGAN/GPSC-inspired external frozen-teacher variant; not a reproduction; 0.1 and 1.0 are a finite loss-weight sensitivity grid including the zero-weight G0 control
basis.confirmation: Budget-bounded new-source confirmation after development; statistical unit is a paired nuisance-condition group
basis.optimization: Preserve V3 LSTM/Adam starting values; 1k/2k/4k checks distinguish limited training from lack of observed information
basis.sampling_seeds: Replication controls only, not independent flight sources
basis.window_candidates: Finite sensitivity study around V3 1s; candidates are engineering budget choices, not established physical constants

config.confirmation_rule: After all development, use group-level paired GAN-minus-matched-ROS validation differences averaged across training seeds: n=clip(ceil((1.96*sample_sd/0.05)^2),6,12). Normal approximation with only three development groups is an unstable budget-planning heuristic, not a power or CI guarantee. Freeze n and first unused sequential nuisance seeds before collection; never top up after test scores.
config.equal_control: Best of 6s/12s raw-prefix validation candidates; diagnostic only, not eligible to replace the selected prefix
config.native_joint_review: Two screened windows x LSTM/CNN x three seeds at selected common-grid update budget; all rebuilt on native-from-zero pools, trained from scratch. Then choose family/window and compare prefix coverage at that fixed budget.
config.paired_seed_design: Index-pair generator142/143/144 and ROS242/243/244 with classifier42/43/44; these are three joint repeats, not a variance decomposition or nine independent flight groups
config.quality_support: Stages report support and both fixed-19 and present-class macro-F1. Timing and phase metadata never enter neural inputs.
config.ranking: For each training seed pool all three validation groups and compute fixed-19 argmax macro-F1; rank by the mean across seeds rounded to 8 decimals. Ties prefer shorter windows, fewer updates, fewer parameters, then family name. All per-group and critical-class results retained; reference selection is not deployment acceptance.
config.reuse_policy: Only exact train-array, scaler, model and optimizer signature matches may resume; changing the endpoint grid always changes the pool identity
config.statistical_baseline: RF200_leaf2_sqrt; channel mean/std/min/max/RMS/mean_abs_difference/lag1_correlation plus pairwise correlations and demeaned PSD band powers
config.teacher_gate: G1 is exploratory and runs only if every class has positive validation recall in every raw-baseline seed AND healthy/remaining-80% joint accuracy exceeds 1/19 in every seed. This only rejects collapsed teachers; it does not certify generated labels.
config.test_policy: V1/V2/V3 test sources are historical/exposed. Only six original train and three original validation groups enter development. New confirmation features and caches remain locked until every selection/model/scaler/alarm policy is immutable.
